Five Arrested in Odisha Gangrape Case

Police in Cuttack, Odisha, have arrested five individuals in connection with the alleged gangrape of a woman. The arrests were made following an investigation into the incident. Further details regarding the circumstances of the alleged crime and the identities of the accused have not been fully disclosed in the coverage.
